r.경제 체제: Market economy · attracting foreign parts factories

t.why: It joined NATO in 2020, but its EU accession is blocked by history and language disputes with Bulgaria.
t.rel: After a name dispute with Greece, it renamed itself North Macedonia in 2019 and joined NATO in 2020. Its EU accession is blocked by language and history disputes with Bulgaria.
t.know: Mother Teresa was born in its capital, Skopje.
t.etext: It has added factories making parts such as catalytic converters and wiring by attracting foreign companies, with EU membership as its goal.
